    "reason": "The clause pertains to intellectual property rights and does not restrict data subject rights under the PDPL."
  },
  {
    "clause_id": "k7",
    "rule_id": "R11",
    "verdict": "violation",
    "confidence": 0.98,

    "reason": "Direct marketing is bundled by default upon account creation without offering a clear and easy way to opt out or stop receiving messages."
  }
